newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq shares clipped by networking stocks.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq shares clipped by networking stocks.

text.p: A downdraft in computer networking stocks sent Nasdaq shares to a lower close.
Investor disappointment in Xylan Corp's fourth quarter earnings and renewed fears of a December sales slowdown at 3Com Corp hit the networking group, traders said.
There was also nervousness ahead of Cisco System Inc's quarterly profit report, they said.
After the close, Cisco reported fiscal second quarter net income of $338.5 million or $0.49 a share, compared with $209.7 million, or $0.31 a share, a year ago.
"Generally speaking there's a lot of nervousness in the (technology) group," said Phil Orlando, chief investment officer of Value Line's Asset Management division.
The Nasdaq composite ended off about 2.3 points at 1374.
3Com dropped 3-1/4 to 58-3/4, Xylan Corp slipped 6-1/2 to 22. Cisco ended off 1-1/8 to 67-1/8.

Among other technology stocks, Dell Computer ended off 1-1/2 to 64-5/8 and Apple Computer Inc dropped 15/16 to 15-3/8. But other tech stocks managed gains, including heavyweights Intel Corp, up 7/8 at 164-3/4, and Microsoft Corp, up 3/4 at 103-1/8.
